integrity: Exact mathematical derivations and a standalone reproducible numerical checker are supplied; finite checks do not replace the proof; source-coverage risks are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The analytical theorem is for bivariate smooth normal-mode copulas of fixed 0<theta<1 with positive integer frequencies; only population coefficients are studied. No finite-sample power claim, derivative-uniformity claim, or independent priority certification is made.
title: A fixed-information, vanishing-rank-dependence law for normal-mode copulas
